# Northwest Siding Contractors of Eugene, Inc.

> Eugene-Springfield's premier exterior contractor and only James Hardie® Exclusive Preferred Remodeler.

## Overview
- Company Name: Northwest Siding Contractors of Eugene, Inc.
- Founded: 1999 (25+ years in business)
- Licensing: CCB #136733 (Licensed, Bonded, Insured)
- Phone: (541) 688-2997
- Email: sidinggurus@northwestsiding.com
- Based In: Eugene, Oregon (also serving from Junction City & Cottage Grove)
- Website: https://northwestsiding.com
- Rating: BBB A+ Rating (zero complaints), 4.9-star customer rating, 2,000+ completed homes

## Core Services
1. James Hardie® Fiber Cement Siding
   - Eugene's only Exclusive Preferred Remodeler
   - Products: HardiePlank® Lap Siding, HardieShingle® Siding, HardiePanel® Vertical Siding, HardieTrim® Boards
   - Full 30-year non-prorated manufacturer warranty backed by James Hardie factory specification installation
   - 3-year workmanship guarantee

2. Cedar & Natural Wood Siding
   - Tight Knot Cedar, Clear Beveled Lap Cedar, Cedar Shingles, and Breckenridge Douglas Fir Panels

3. Replacement Windows
   - Certified Milgard® installer
   - Milgard Tuscany® Series, Montecito® Series, and Style Line Series® vinyl and fiberglass windows

4. Seamless Gutters
   - Custom continuous on-site fabrication of 5" K-style and 6" fascia-style seamless steel and aluminum gutters

5. Interior & Exterior Painting
   - Full interior and exterior surface preparation, dry rot repair, caulking, and commercial-grade painting

6. Roofing
   - Roof replacement and repair

7. Decks & Additions
   - Custom deck construction and home additions

8. Fencing & Gates
   - Fence and gate design, construction, and installation
